snippet.title: CorpseOcean (Full Playthrough, All Secrets, All Tapes) A deep sea diving horror game!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://akuma-kira.itch.io/corpseocean?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Pilot a tiny submersible on a job to retrieve organic material from a sunken navy sub. Follow the coordinates, use Sonar and hope you don't run into anything on the way.

VHS tape locations are hidden in the top right corner of the ending screen (shown in 13:26)
